politics.supreme_leader: Mojtaba Khamenei, since early 2026, following the assassination of his father Ali Khamenei in the opening US-Israeli strikes of the 2026 Iran War (28 Feb 2026)
politics.current_crisis: Iran has been at war with the US and Israel since 28 Feb 2026 ('Operation Epic Fury' / 'Operation Roaring Lion' / Iran's 'Operation True Promise IV'). Opening strikes killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and senior officials. A conditional ceasefire (8 Apr-8 Jul 2026), mediated by Pakistan, broke down; fighting resumed 8 Jul 2026. Iran has periodically threatened and briefly disrupted Strait of Hormuz shipping, drawing further US retaliation.

vulnerabilities: Active war with the US and Israel since 28 February 2026 has killed the Supreme Leader and senior military/political leadership, destroyed a large share of military and nuclear infrastructure, and left the regime in its most precarious position in decades
Severe macroeconomic sanctions strain — US secondary sanctions and financial clearing bans have driven currency devaluation and social friction, partly offset by shadow-fleet petroleum sales to China
Conventional air force and air-defence obsolescence — a legacy fighter inventory (F-14, F-4, MiG-29) cannot contest air superiority against high-end air forces
Extreme concentration of crude oil exports through the single Kharg Island terminal — over 80% of export volume, a single point of catastrophic economic failure if struck
Domestic political instability and civil discontent diverting internal security resources from external strategic operations
Water scarcity and environmental stress from depleted aquifers, compounding socio-economic instability
strengths: Geographic command of the Strait of Hormuz's northern coastline — anti-ship missiles, fast attack craft, and sea mines enable credible closure/interdiction threats
Extensive integrated asymmetric proxy network ('Axis of Resistance': Hezbollah, Houthis, Iraqi militias) projecting power multi-directionally without direct Iranian exposure
Largest ballistic missile and one-way attack drone inventory in the Middle East (Shahed-series loitering munitions, Khorramshahr/Emad ballistic missiles)
Threshold nuclear weapons capability — enrichment above 60% purity at Fordow/Natanz creates rapid breakout potential
Zagros mountain range forms a natural land fortress housing deep underground missile facilities
